positive.prompt: Keep reviewing and fixing this branch until high findings clear or the bounded loop stops.
Run another durable review/fix iteration and detect convergence, stalling, or exhaustion.
Drive repeated verified reviews on a dedicated loop branch with a hard pass limit.

negative.prompt: Perform one multi-lens adversarial review of this pull request before merge.
Implement this one assigned issue and open its isolated pull request.

evals.prompt: Two consecutive passes contain the identical set of high findings, although a nit disappeared on the second pass.
evals.expected_output: A stalled loop result with the repeated blocking findings and no further builder dispatch.
expectations: The loop stops as stalled because findings at or above the configured threshold did not change.
The lower-severity improvement does not reset stall detection or trigger another fix pass.
